Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.service.base

Class AbstractBaseQueryResourceService<E,ResponseDTO,ID,FilterDTO extends GenericFilterDTO>

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.service.base.AbstractBaseQueryResourceService<E,ResponseDTO,ID,FilterDTO>
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseResourceQueryService<ResponseDTO,ID,FilterDTO>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractBaseResourceService, AbstractReadOnlyResourceService
public abstract class AbstractBaseQueryResourceService<E,ResponseDTO,ID,FilterDTO extends GenericFilterDTO> extends Object implements BaseResourceQueryService<ResponseDTO,ID,FilterDTO>
Base query-only do novo core resource-oriented.

Esta hierarquia concentra a superficie de leitura, options, option-sources e stats sem carregar semantica de escrita. Recursos read-only nascem diretamente daqui; recursos mutantes sobem para AbstractBaseResourceService apenas quando realmente precisam de create/update/delete.

    • supportsSeededStateSnapshotReuse

      protected boolean supportsSeededStateSnapshotReuse()
      Indicates whether the snapshot computed during findById(Object) or assertItemAccessible(Object) is semantically equivalent to calling findResourceStateSnapshot(Object), allowing
      invalid reference 
      ResourceServiceDelegatingStateSnapshotProvider
      to reuse it safely within the active
      invalid reference 
      ResourceStateSnapshotScope
      without invoking findResourceStateSnapshot again through AOP proxies.

      Subclasses that override findResourceStateSnapshot(Object) only to map absent/denied errors around super.findResourceStateSnapshot(id) may opt back in by returning true.

    • getEntityResourceVersion

      protected OptionalLong getEntityResourceVersion(E entity)
      Reads a numeric JPA @Version from the supplied entity through a cached field/getter accessor. Overrides may project another persisted numeric revision, but must never reload the entity, query a second revision or substitute an expected client version. Missing/non-numeric revisions remain empty; versioned mutations reject them before reporting success.

    • resolveResourceFilterAccessScope

      protected ResourceFilterAccessScope<E> resolveResourceFilterAccessScope()
      Resolves the mandatory server-side row scope for resource filter queries.

      The default is explicitly unrestricted so existing global resources preserve their behavior. Applications with row-level authorization should override this hook and return a restricted or denied scope from authenticated server context. A client FilterDTO, includeIds, aliases, or textual matching must never decide this scope.

    • resolveScopedTitlesByIds

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public Map<ID,String> resolveScopedTitlesByIds(Collection<ID> ids)
      Resolves human-readable display titles for a batch of entity IDs strictly within the current tenant/access scope (resolveResourceFilterAccessScope()).

      Executes a single bounded query via findEntitiesByIdWithinAccessScope(java.util.Collection<ID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification<E>) and never leaks titles of records outside the caller's authorized scope.

    • normalizeOptionSourceFilter

      protected FilterDTO normalizeOptionSourceFilter(OptionSourceDescriptor descriptor, OptionSourceOperation operation, FilterDTO filter)
      Applies resource-owned constraints to every execution path of a derived option source.

      The option-source descriptor describes discovery and query capabilities, but it must not become the authority for row-level access. A resource with a principal-dependent scope can override this hook to intersect the supplied filter (or create one for GET by-ids) before the JPA specification is derived.
